errata.disposition: RFC Editor search returned No matching errata found for RFC9289 at capture. This is the observed search result, not proof no erratum can exist. ALPN placement discrepancy remains a source discrepancy, not a verified erratum.

discrepancies.disposition: RFC9289 section5 says ServerHello. TLS1.3 and IANA restrict server ALPN selection to EncryptedExtensions. Model CH offer and encrypted EE selection; errata search observed no matching entries, not a verified erratum.

restrictions.rule: MUST NOT reuse binding for more than one authentication mechanism instance on TLS connection; MUST immediately close TLS after upper-layer protocol. NFS14 deferred.
RPCSEC_GSSv3 not implemented; no advanced labels/delegation claim.
Server v2/v3/v4.1; built-in Client v2/v3; no v4.0/v4.2 inferred. krb5/i/p documented; enctype17 fixture not19 interoperability claim.

supportBoundary: All sources are documentation snapshots only. No kernel/config/package versions, live native mounts, Windows build, cross-platform interoperability or byte-level crypto conformance observed.

implementationDispositions.claim: SETCLIENTID/SETCLIENTID_CONFIRM are 16.33/16.34, not 16.35/16.36. The chosen v4.0 OPEN sets OPEN4_RESULT_CONFIRM and requires OPEN_CONFIRM before READ. This is a worksheet citation correction, not an alleged RFC erratum.

The selected boundary fails LOOKUP, not its immediately preceding PUTFH. SECINFO consumes current FH. SECINFO_NO_NAME CURRENT_FH alternate explicitly requires a separately cached target handle, not an invented handle learned from failed LOOKUP. Each compound consumes a distinct session slot sequence; retry caches NFS results, not a reusable GSS envelope. The consumed-handle negative sends actual SECINFO followed by GETFH in the same compound; server is the first detector and returns earlier successful results plus NFS4ERR_NOFILEHANDLE. Client learns it only after protected response verification, not a local fabricated server status.

Duplicate GSS sequence is silently discarded, followed only by client timeout. Integrity/privacy argument failure is MSG_ACCEPTED/GARBAGE_ARGS. Header MIC, embedded GSS sequence/body protection and independent NFS slot sequencing remain distinct. Context destruction replies while the server context still exists, then disposes it; client verifies response before its local disposal.
Captured rpc.gssd manual explicitly describes RFC7861 third GSS version as not currently implemented. No advanced GSSv3 model was authored.

Captured Microsoft support tables list Windows Server NFS2/3/4.1 and built-in Windows client NFS2/3. This fixed Linux-to-Windows Server2025 comparison uses4.1 and symbolic enctype17, not unverified4.0/4.2, AES-SHA2 or native interoperability.
Captured evolving draft is contextual only and does not replace the selected published RFC8881 authority.

implementationDispositions.observedRevision: RFC9846 July2026, obsoletes RFC8446 and others
implementationDispositions.claim: TLS1.3 ALPN selection is in EncryptedExtensions, not ServerHello; certificate signing keys are not traffic-secret KDF inputs. Application traffic secret0 derives through server Finished.

RFC9266 application-binding restrictions are recorded, not generalized into a GSSv3 implementation: do not bind more than one authentication mechanism instance to a TLS connection, and immediately close after the upper-layer protocol completes.

implementationLimits: 13 core models and70 named comparisons/negatives are symbolic offline standards/documentation fixtures, not native mounts or independently tested Linux/Windows product builds.

All31 frozen primary references plus the separate RFC9289 errata-search response are captured unchanged. The observed search returned No matching errata found; the ALPN source discrepancy is not called a verified erratum.
NFS14 remains a deferred optional record with no runtime model. No optional unsupported GSSv3, callbacks/delegations, pNFS, live PKI/KDC/file server or real production crypto is invented.
Named source/platform support claims stay bounded to the captured revisions and selected profile; man7 manual render dates are not exact nfs-utils commit verification.
